title: PoliMi study notebooks
intro: Interactive notebooks for the courses I take: every lecture rewritten as lessons with figures, live demos, past-exam exercises with model answers and a quiz at the end of each lesson.
disclaimer: Personal study notes. They are not official course material and are not endorsed by Politecnico di Milano or the course instructors. Quotations from the course slides are used for study purposes; the model answers are the author's own, since no official solutions are published.
